source_columns: UCEST_YT, UCEST_SVAKOD_YT, UCEST_TIKTOK, UCEST_SVAKOD_TIKTOK
expression:
local({
  days <- c(0, 0.35, 1, 4, 7)
  hours <- c(2, 4, 6.5, 8)
  youtube <- ifelse(
    as.numeric(UCEST_YT) == 0,
    0,
    hours[as.numeric(UCEST_SVAKOD_YT)] * days[as.numeric(UCEST_YT) + 1] / 7
  )
  tiktok <- ifelse(
    as.numeric(UCEST_TIKTOK) == 0,
    0,
    hours[as.numeric(UCEST_SVAKOD_TIKTOK)] * days[as.numeric(UCEST_TIKTOK) + 1] / 7
  )
  youtube + tiktok
})
notes: Sum of UCEST_SVAKOD_YT, UCEST_SVAKOD_TIKTOK parts (DR-0002). YouTube and TikTok only; top band >8 h = 8. Online video, so not on st_socmedia although listed under 'SOCIAL NETWORKS'. Self-report, 'how many hours you use it approximately per day', a table meant for daily users of each app. Day-of-use reading: band value (1-3 h = 2, 3-5 h = 4, 5-8 h = 6.5, top band >8 h = 8) x days / 7, days from the paired frequency item (never 0, 1-2 times a month 0.35, about once a week 1, several times a week 4, daily 7). Hours answered without daily use, read as time on a day of use: YouTube 63, TikTok 39. Never with hours blank = 0; below daily with hours blank, daily with hours blank, or frequency missing = NA, and any NA part leaves the sum NA. No TV, film or other video item was asked.
